false_assumption.statement: Edris Temperley truly loves Seton Darville and is faithful to him.
false_assumption.why_it_seems_reasonable: Edris repeatedly professes love and affection to Darville, and publicly behaves as his devoted lover. Her actions and words create a convincing appearance of loyalty.
false_assumption.what_it_hides: Edris is secretly engaged to Karl Weiss and deceives Darville with false professions of love, betraying him emotionally and romantically.

mechanism_description: The Caborns attempted to destroy the Forth Bridge by attaching liquid explosives concealed in rubber hot-water bottles connected to electrical detonators. Seton Darville secretly disabled the detonators by placing paper discs under the electrical terminals, preventing the circuit from completing. Meanwhile, Darville orchestrated a trap by offering Karl Weiss a secret mission to Russia, effectively removing him as a rival and neutralizing the espionage threat.

discriminating_test.design: Darville disables the electrical detonators by placing paper discs under the brass screw caps of the terminals, preventing the circuit from completing. The test is to observe if the explosives detonate when the circuit is triggered. If no detonation occurs, the sabotage attempt is foiled and the mechanism is proven.
discriminating_test.knowledge_revealed: This test reveals that the explosives cannot be detonated remotely due to the disabled electrical contacts, confirming the sabotage was neutralized.
discriminating_test.pass_condition: The explosives fail to detonate when the circuit is activated, proving the sabotage mechanism was disabled.
